own_solution.law: Snell's law at the entry face (sin 40 = 1.8 sin r); meridional zig-zag ray path length L/cos r; speed in glass c/n; t = n L / (c cos r)
assumptions: meridional ray (enters at centre of face)
TIR at sides holds: side incidence 90-20.92 = 69.08 deg > critical 33.75 deg

notes: sin r = 0.642788/1.8 = 0.357104, cos r = 0.934065; t = 3.6/(3e8*0.934065) = 12.847 ns; with 3.3 m rod t = 5.94/2.802195e8 = 21.198 ns. Diameter sets the reflection spacing/number (N = L tan r / d, segment d/sin r) but cancels from total path L/cos r, hence C. Earlier-run lengthening has no effect on the present pulse (rod is at its stated 2 m as first cut); I label it D (temporal detachment) rather than K. Variant sets: 1.3 m on rod (now) / rod (earlier) / cable share number and unit; the 'short length' sentences (T97AD, TACC7) carry no number and are variants of each other only. The 'as first cut' clause keeps the lengthening sentences consistent with the stated 2 m.
